title: ci_stalled
description: The run sits in its CI step with no checks reported past the grace time, and GitHub confirms the PR has none. Replay-prone. Written by: pipeline-watch.sh (actor watcher). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

run_id.description: The pipeline run. The watcher always sets it.

branch.description: The run's branch. The watcher always sets it (the issue comes from its issue-<N>).

head.description: The run's head sha (head_sha), null when unreadable.

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: reason=no-workflow (the repo has no workflows) or reason=no-checks (none ran). Read by the factory loop (plan.ts, rules P6, P6a). Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
